tasks.title: Complete Cursor Mapping Bidirectional Conversion
tasks.description: Review and fix cursor mapping edge cases in dom_to_source() including nested formatting, multi-byte characters, CRLF line endings, HTML entity encoding, empty nodes, and document boundary positions. Ensure bidirectional round-trip accuracy.
test_criteria: cargo test passes for cursor_mapping module

test_cases.name: Nested formatting conversion
test_cases.description: Verify cursor position maps correctly when nested formatting exists
test_cases.expected_behavior: Cursor at any position in nested structure maps correctly between source and DOM

test_cases.name: Unicode multi-byte characters
test_cases.description: Verify cursor maps correctly with Unicode emojis and accented characters
test_cases.expected_behavior: Cursor positions remain accurate with multi-byte Unicode characters

test_cases.name: CRLF line endings handling
test_cases.description: Verify cursor mapping handles CRLF (\r\n) line endings correctly
test_cases.expected_behavior: CRLF normalized to LF without cursor position drift

test_cases.name: HTML entity encoding
test_cases.description: Verify HTML entities (&, <, >, ") map correctly
test_cases.expected_behavior: HTML entities converted correctly in both directions

test_cases.name: Empty and zero-width nodes
test_cases.description: Verify cursor mapping handles empty nodes (empty strong, empty em)
test_cases.expected_behavior: Empty formatting nodes handled without crash or position errors

test_cases.name: Document boundary positions
test_cases.description: Verify cursor at document start and end maps correctly
test_cases.expected_behavior: Cursor at position 0 and end-of-document maps correctly

test_cases.name: Round-trip source→DOM→source
test_cases.description: Verify source→DOM→source produces original content
test_cases.expected_behavior: After source→DOM→source conversion, content equals original

test_cases.name: Round-trip DOM→source→DOM
test_cases.description: Verify DOM→source→DOM produces equivalent structure
test_cases.expected_behavior: After DOM→source→DOM conversion, structure is semantically equivalent

tasks.impl_notes: Focus on dom_to_source() edge cases. Review CursorMapping struct, build_cursor_mapping(), and dom_to_source() implementations. Add comprehensive tests for all identified edge cases.
